name: Black Fury
text: Magical ability. Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to this fighter's Fight characteristic. This fighter may immediately make a free move action followed by a free melee attack action.

name: Frenzy
text: When this fighter is activated, if there is a visible enemy fighter within a distance equal to its Move characteristic plus 3", it must make a move action that ends as close as possible to the nearest such fighter and then a melee attack action if it is able to. This fighter cannot make retreat actions.

name: Liturgus Infecticus
text: While this fighter has not been taken out of action, friendly CLAN PESTILENS fighters may re-roll failed Bravery tests.

name: Manifestation of the Final Pandemic
text: Select up to (X/2) enemy fighters, each visible and within 6" of this fighter or within 3" of a corrupted objective marker. Allocate 2 damage points to each of them.

name: Warpfire
text: Magical ability. Allocate (X) damage points to the closest visible enemy fighter within 8" of this fighter, and 1 damage point to each other fighter within 2" of it.
